assertion_analysis.fails_if: No support slots are populated; CORE count is replaced by mask changes; settled support is zero; or the synthetic solve never settles after changing its mask.
Any non-CORE label is counted, or per-trip support is replaced by the change history: expected values are independently fixed at [1,1].

An executed empty-support slot contains a positive change count, or the synthetic mask no longer changes then settles; support equality alone is vacuous if no slots are recorded, with population coverage supplied by the other two loop tests.
The production publication swaps/drops the histories or routes support to the change field; literal expected values 345 and 0 are distinct and the logged mutation fails.
A plain route publishes active-set counters, loses its scalar change count 7, or publishes support slots instead of an empty history.
Publication no longer copies the stored history; does not fail if that source never records population, since both sides share its default -1.
The pinned dataclass field schema retains the old field or omits either new field.

failure_delta_evidence.coverage: Observed completed summaries only; 6 identical failure ids including H200 forward solve. Reduced-constraints aborted on both arms before its summary, so zero is the observed delta, not proof of complete regression coverage.

findings.text: blocking: reduced_newton is selected as an active-set route, but _solve_constrained_reduced at lines 2407-2430 never sets active_set_support_cells, so support_cell_count becomes the scalar default -1 from fixed_point.py:524 rather than a per-trip population or the explicit empty history used for unavailable routes; downstream indexing of this advertised history fails and its values cannot describe support.

blocking: the added support assertion compares receipt.support_cell_count with receipt.equilibrium.fixed_point.active_set_support_cells, the same source the publication copies, so the existing missing-count defect leaves both sides equal to -1; removing support collection still passes this assertion, which therefore does not protect reduced-route support measurement.

blocking: baseline_suite and after_suite declare completed=true although both reduced-constraints processes aborted before the summary and yielded no failing test ids; equal exit 134 codes do not establish equal failures, so the asserted complete zero-added-failures measure needs completed evidence or an explicit unresolved gate.
